assumptions: The build is not green as a whole. Accepted rows in suites 135, 138, 139 and 140 pin what AC1, AC5 and table 2 replace; the lead named other rows, so these were left unchanged and red, and the spec History lists them for a decision.
Lead decision 2: table 2 is issued and table 1 is not edited. No line of the registry or the design allows a row to be added to an issued table.
Lead decision 3: a clone request offers Keep alone, because no criterion asks for a remover that carries a Save or a Discard of a private repository. That remover is a follow-up.
A blob the store holds is read as a row of the store entities whose digest is the file digest and whose own content, encoded again, has it. The store has no other blob table.
The trunk is the one the caller of Signal names. No caller in the footprint names one yet, so until then evidence is removed only on a copy in the store or in a commit a kept ref reaches.
A worker clone is known by its form and by the provisioner manifest beside it under the state root, read with no link followed, naming the item run as its one worker.
A build output folder inside a worker clone is not saved and is deleted with the clone; a file in it is build output by the committed ignore rule or a declared pattern.
ac3/renamed-back uses the two-name reading reconcile itself uses (places); the whole reconcile run is not driven, and suite 156 was not run.
The four creator modules of the footprint did not change: they declare the form since VELDO-0302.
For a remote on another host the remote-tracking ref is all that is read (design 0.9).
Fixture process table and pool space do not establish host-reader readiness.
Suites 151 and up and scripts/verify.sh were not run. All criteria remain pending aggregate verification and independent review.
